feed_summary: CVE-2026-19868 can let attackers holding credentials for a different login method get past SAML checks, including SAML-enforced MFA. The post SonicWall Patches Exploited SonicOS Vulnerability That Weakens VPN Logins appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: SonicWall Patches Exploited SonicOS Vulnerability That Weakens VPN Logins
